purpose: Enforce latest user time-step ceiling and run a fixed-design short-window diagnostic; no engineering ranking
duration_scope: A synthetic 12-second window, not a representative complete multilayer process or long production layer
selection: Same frozen coarse-trained designs and original first four holdout draws, without search
numerical_screen: Each method's last two mean-CV changes and paired-gap changes <20% of current diagnostic gap, same sign over all three time rungs; a heuristic, not an error bound
engineering_blockers: 12-second window is not a representative full process
Designs were optimized at now-ineligible 0.125-second coarse training steps
